title: Scalar extension commutes with open-restriction exchange
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a unital morphism of commutative rings and let $k:U\to V$, $r:U\to W$, $p:V\to Z$, $i:W\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $p\circ k=i\circ r$ and $k,i$ open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]. On the small etale constant-module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], write $T_X:D(X_{et},A)\to D(X_{et},B)$ for derived scalar extension, $q_f:T Rf_{*,A}\to Rf_{*,B}T$ for the specified coefficient map [lem-coef-finite-direct-image], $r_j:j_A^*T\xrightarrow{\sim}Tj_B^*$ for the specified open scalar/restriction comparison [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor], and $\mathrm{Ex}_R:i_R^*Rp_{*,R}\to Rr_{*,R}k_R^*$ for the exact unbounded counit-mate exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange]. For every $M\in D(V_{et},A)$ the equality $Rr_{*,B}(r_k(M)^{-1})\circ\mathrm{Ex}_B(T_VM)\circ i_B^*(q_p(M))=q_r(k_A^*M)\circ T_W(\mathrm{Ex}_A(M))\circ r_i(Rp_{*,A}M)^{-1}$ holds. No cartesianness, properness, finiteness, boundedness or flatness assumption is needed.

proof.text: Identify the two sheaf-level restriction-of-scalars/pullback composites by uniqueness of the left adjoints of direct image followed by coextension. Their compatibility with composition gives the commutative inverse-image square. Descend this identity to unbounded derived categories by naturality of the exact localization comparison on complexes.

Taking mates under the four scalar adjunctions gives the scalar/pullback cube. For open immersions the geometric mate of the sectionwise identity is the direct-image/restriction identification, by the site adjunction triangle identity. Hence its exact derived comparison agrees with openDerivedRestrictScalarsIso, and its inverse scalar mate is precisely openScalarRestriction. For arbitrary vertical maps, transport along the exact-versus-left-derived inverse-image isomorphism identifies this mate with scalarPullbackEtaleIso.symm. Its invertibility is scalarPullbackReverse_isIso.

The defining scalar-unit equation for finiteCoefficientDirectImageMap determines its geometric counit transpose. Cancel the scalar adjunction unit using the Hom equivalence and the invertibility of the reverse scalar mate. Transport this formula from left-derived inverse image to the exact derived inverse-image adjunction; equality of the adjunctions follows from their units on homotopy-category objects and localization.

Apply coefficient_exchange_of_counit to the scalar/pullback cube, with the canonical exactDerivedBaseChangeMap and its mateEquiv_counit equation on each side. Multiply by the inverse horizontal scalar comparisons and cancel. Neither direct-image coefficient map nor exchange map is inverted. The assertion is valid for a commutative square, without cartesianness, properness, finiteness, boundedness, or flatness.

lean.statement:
theorem openRestriction_scalar_exchange
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}}
    {k : U ⟶ V} {r : U ⟶ W} {p : V ⟶ Z} {i : W ⟶ Z}
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (sq : CommSq k r p i) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A V) :
    D((i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} B]).map (finiteCoefficientDirectImageMap φ p M) ≫
      (exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) sq).app
        ((scalarExtension φ V).obj M) ≫
      R((r)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} B]).map ((openScalarRestriction φ k).inv.app M) =
    (openScalarRestriction φ i).inv.app (R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M) ≫
      (scalarExtension φ W).map
        ((exactDerivedBaseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq).app M) ≫
      finiteCoefficientDirectImageMap φ r (D((k)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj M)
